scripts.test: pnpm -r test && node apps/web/scripts/build.mjs && node --test apps/web/test/build.test.mjs apps/web/test/live-client.test.mjs test/**/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm -r typecheck && node --check apps/web/scripts/build.mjs && node --check apps/web/test/build.test.mjs && node --check apps/web/test/live-client.test.mjs && node --check test/n8n-security.test.mjs
scripts.lint: pnpm build && pnpm -r typecheck && node scripts/lint-javascript.mjs
